Class Session

java.lang.Object
bg.tu_varna.sit.cs.f24621858.commands.Session
public class Session extends Object
Represents a user editing session.

A session is created by the load command and holds:

  • One or more NetpbmFormatImage objects loaded from disk.
  • An ordered queue of Transformation objects that are pending application (they are applied lazily on save / save as).

Primary image rule: the first image added to a session is called the primary image. save as writes only the primary image to the user-specified path; save writes all images.

Transformation ordering: transformations are applied in FIFO order. Calling undoLastTransformation() removes the most recently enqueued transformation.

Author:
Dmitro Dashchenko

    • addImage

      public boolean addImage(NetpbmFormatImage image)
      Adds an image to this session.

      Transformations already queued before this call are not applied to the newly added image when saving.

      Parameters:
      image - the image to add; must not be null
      Returns:
      true if an image is added to the session, false otherwise
